objective: Frozen computation: exact KF3 laws over classes of disagreement tables (with the state count) from every presentation up to mirror of lines of 5 to 9, k = 0 to 4 new distinctions; in-law separation of bare bracketings and placements, and per-sample identification of the bare bracketing and of the presentation from one grown table.
status: Supported 2026-11-18 (referee pending; 4 of 5 predictions held): before growth the disagreement counts carry none of how the knots nest; one KF3-grown base's table carries at most about two thirds of the information about the bare bracketing (0.63, 0.65, 0.62 at five, six, seven, peaking near n0 - 4 new distinctions, then falling; D3 failed on timing at seven to nine), below the bag-of-knots null at every k >= 2, more than the unlabelled multiset; in law bare bracketings separate from k = 1 and non-mirror presentations from k = 2.
title: What the grown disagreement counts reveal of the nesting
